name: [❄] Zombie Rush!
desc:
Survive the ultimate zombie apocalypse! Blast through hordes, level up, and unlock powerful weapons. Play as a survivor and fight to stay alive, respawn as a zombie to finish the fight 🧟‍♂️

⚔️ Use melee and ranged weapons to clear the horde
👑 Defeat zombie bosses for rare drops
💣 Complete missions, earn XP, and unlock new gear
🏆 Climb the leaderboards to prove your skill
